plugins.name: deck-kit
plugins.description: Build a pitch deck as code. One shared kit (reveal.js, a layout and motion stylesheet, three themes), a tool that scaffolds, screenshots and exports a PDF, and a skill carrying the narrative frameworks, the visual system and the pre-send checklist. Decks come out brand-exact, reviewable in git, and identical on a laptop, a 4K monitor and a boardroom projector.
